Operating System.title: Basic OS Name
Operating System.desc: Retrieves the simple name of the operating system

Operating System.title: Basic OS Version
Operating System.desc: Retrieves the version of the operating system

Operating System.title: Basic OS Architecture
Operating System.desc: Checks the architecture of the operating system (e.g., x86_64, i386)

Operating System.title: System Uptime
Operating System.desc: Retrieves the current uptime of the machine

Operating System.title: OS Identification & Build Forensics
Operating System.desc: Core OS identity including versions, high/low build components, and release IDs
Operating System.code: (name of it | "None", version of it as string | "None", build number of it as string | "None", build number high of it | 0, build number low of it | 0, release of it as string | "None", releaseid of it | "None", display name of it | "None", display version of it | "None") of operating system

Operating System.title: OS Platform & Architecture Flags
Operating System.desc: Boolean classification for platform types and architectural bitness
Operating System.code: (architecture of it | "None", (windows of it | false, linux of it | false, mac of it | false, unix of it | false, embedded of it | false), (x32 of it | false, x64 of it | false, ia64 of it | false), major version of it | 0, minor version of it | 0, platform id of it | 0) of operating system

Operating System.title: OS Service, Tech Level & Security
Operating System.desc: CSD versions, service pack details, and suite/product masking
Operating System.code: (csd version of it | "None", service pack major version of it | 0, service pack minor version of it | 0, suite mask of it as string | "None", product info numeric of it | 0, product info string of it | "None") of operating system

Operating System.title: System Performance & Runtime State
Operating System.desc: Uptime metrics, hypervisor identification, and performance counter frequencies
Operating System.code: (boot time of it as string | "None", uptime of it as string | "None", hypervisor of it | "None", virtual machine of it | false, uuid of it as string | "None", performance counter of it | 0, performance counter frequency of it as string | "None", (big endian of it | false, little endian of it | false)) of operating system

Processor.title: Processor Brand String
Processor.desc: Retrieves the human-readable brand name of the processor

Processor.title: Processor Speed
Processor.desc: Retrieves the speed of the main processor

Processor.title: Processor ID & Branding
Processor.desc: Vendor identification, brand strings, and hardware revision/stepping details
Processor.code: (brand string of it | "None", vendor name of it | "None", family name of it | "None", family of it as string | "None", model of it as string | "None", stepping of it | 0, brand id of it | 0, vendor name of it | "None") of main processor

Processes.title: List Process Names
Processes.desc: Returns a simple list of all running process names

Processes.title: List Process PIDs
Processes.desc: Returns a simple list of all running process IDs

Processes.title: Check Specific Process
Processes.desc: Checks if a specific process is currently running

Processes.title: Process Core Identity
Processes.desc: Name, PID, Parent PID, and session ID
Processes.code: (name of it | "None", pid of it | 0, ppid of it | 0, session id of it | 0) of processes

Processes.title: Process Resource & Memory Forensics
Processes.desc: Handle counts, working set sizes, and page fault metrics
Processes.code: (working set size of it | 0, peak working set size of it | 0, page fault count of it | 0, page file usage of it | 0, peak page file usage of it | 0, handle count of it | 0, gdi object count of it | 0, user object count of it | 0) of processes

Processes.title: Process Security & Execution Flags
Processes.desc: User context, WOW64 status, and hardware security (DEP/NX), plus timing
Processes.code: (user of it as string | "None", (wow64 of it | false, dep enabled of it | false, nx bit of it | false), creation time of it as string | "None", user time of it as string | "None", kernel time of it as string | "None") of processes

Processes.title: Process I/O Statistics
Processes.desc: Detailed read/write/other I/O operation counts and total sizes
Processes.code: (name of it | "None", io read count of it | 0, io read size of it | 0, io write count of it | 0, io write size of it | 0, io other count of it | 0, io other size of it | 0) of processes

Services.title: List Service Names
Services.desc: Returns a list of all service names on the system

Services.title: List Running Services
Services.desc: Returns a list of services that are currently running
Services.code: service names of services whose (running of it)

Services.title: Specific Service State
Services.desc: Returns the current state of a named service

Services.title: Service Config & Interaction
Services.desc: Operational state, start types, and desktop interaction capability
Services.code: (service name of it | "None", display name of it | "None", state of it | "None", start type of it | "None", login account of it | "None", (can interact with desktop of it | false, running of it | false, win32 type of it | false, driver type of it | false)) of services

Services.title: Service Runtime Forensics
Services.desc: PID, binary path, and system exit codes for troubleshooting
Services.code: (pid of it | 0, image path of it | "None", checkpoint of it | 0, win32 exit code of it | 0, service specific exit code of it | 0, version of it as string | "None") of services

Services.title: Service Security & Files
Services.desc: Security descriptor ownership and associated service executable file
Services.code: (service name of it | "None", owner of security descriptor of it as string | "None", group of security descriptor of it as string | "None", pathname of file of it | "None") of services

Drives & Storage.title: List Drive Names
Drives & Storage.desc: Returns a simple list of all drive letters/names

Drives & Storage.title: Free Space on C: Drive
Drives & Storage.desc: Returns the free space in bytes for the C: drive

Drives & Storage.title: Total Space on C: Drive
Drives & Storage.desc: Returns the total capacity in bytes for the C: drive

Drives & Storage.title: Drive Identity & Logic
Drives & Storage.desc: Volume names, file system types, and numeric type classification
Drives & Storage.code: (name of it | "None", type of it | "None", numeric type of it | 0, volume of it | "None", file system type of it | "None") of drives

Drives & Storage.title: Drive Filesystem Feature Flags
Drives & Storage.desc: Advanced support flags for encryption, ACLs, quotas, and compression
Drives & Storage.code: (name of it | "None", (fs_case_sensitive of it | false, fs_case_is_preserved of it | false, fs_persistent_acls of it | false, fs_unicode_stored_on_disk of it | false), (file_supports_encryption of it | false, file_supports_sparse_files of it | false, file_supports_reparse_points of it | false, file_supports_object_ids of it | false), (fs_vol_is_compressed of it | false, file_volume_quotas of it | false)) of drives

Drives & Storage.title: Drive Capacity & Metrics
Drives & Storage.desc: Total vs Free space byte counts and calculated utilization percentage
Drives & Storage.code: (name of it | "None", total space of it | 0, free space of it | 0, (((free space of it * 100) / total space of it) as string & "%25") | "0%25") of drives

Registry.title: Check if Registry Key Exists
Registry.desc: Simply checks for the existence of a specific registry key

Registry.title: Get Specific Registry Value
Registry.desc: Retrieves the data of a specific registry value
Registry.code: (value "ProgramPath" of it as string | "None") of key "HKLM\SOFTWARE\BigFix\EnterpriseClient" of registry

Registry.title: Registry Key Meta-Data
Registry.desc: Path, last write time (for change detection), and WOW64 redirection context
Registry.code: (name of it | "None", pathname of it | "None", last write time of it as string | "None", (wow64 of it | false)) of keys "HKLM\SOFTWARE\BigFix\EnterpriseClient" of registry

Registry.title: Registry Key Security
Registry.desc: Security descriptor analysis including owner and DACL/SACL presence
Registry.code: (name of it | "None", owner of security descriptor of it as string | "None", group of security descriptor of it as string | "None", null dacl of security descriptor of it | false, null sacl of security descriptor of it | false) of keys "HKLM\SOFTWARE\BigFix\EnterpriseClient" of registry

Registry.title: Registry Value Deep Dive
Registry.desc: Inspection of value data, types (REG_SZ/DWORD), and sizes
Registry.code: (name of it | "None", it as string | "None", type of it as string | "None", size of it | 0) of values of keys "HKLM\SOFTWARE\BigFix\EnterpriseClient" of registry

Files & Folders.title: Check if File Exists
Files & Folders.desc: Verifies the existence of a file by its exact path

Files & Folders.title: Get File Size
Files & Folders.desc: Returns the size of a specific file in bytes

Files & Folders.title: Check if Folder Exists
Files & Folders.desc: Verifies the existence of a directory

Files & Folders.title: File Forensic Block
Files & Folders.desc: File size, versioning, and cryptographic hashes
Files & Folders.code: (name of it | "None", size of it | 0, version of it as string | "None", product version of it as string | "None", md5 of it | "None", sha1 of it | "None", sha256 of it | "None") of files "mshtml.dll" of system folder

Files & Folders.title: File Timing & Security
Files & Folders.desc: Full path, modification times, and ACL/Owner info
Files & Folders.code: (pathname of it | "None", modification time of it as string | "None", owner of security descriptor of it as string | "None", group of security descriptor of it as string | "None") of files "mshtml.dll" of system folder

Files & Folders.title: Folder Hierarchy & Security
Files & Folders.desc: Parent directory relationship and security descriptor integrity
Files & Folders.code: (pathname of it | "None", name of parent folder of it | "None", owner of security descriptor of it as string | "None", null dacl of security descriptor of it | false) of (windows folder; system folder)

Applications.title: List Registered Apps
Applications.desc: Returns a simple list of registered application executable names

Applications.title: Get Version of Specific App
Applications.desc: Retrieves the version string of a specific registered application

Applications.title: Application Object Audit
Applications.desc: Registered application details, task names, and virtualizer contexts
Applications.code: (name of it | "None", version of it as string | "None", task name of it | "None", virtualizer of it | "None", (inspectability of it | false)) of regapps

Users & Groups.title: Current Logged-in User
Users & Groups.desc: Retrieves the name of the currently logged-in user

Users & Groups.title: List Local Users
Users & Groups.desc: Returns a simple list of all local user accounts

Users & Groups.title: Check if Local Group Exists
Users & Groups.desc: Verifies the existence of a specific local group

Users & Groups.title: User Profile & SID Mapping
Users & Groups.desc: SIDs resolved to names and profile home directory locations
Users & Groups.code: (name of it | "None", sid of it as string | "None", account name of sid of it | "None", domain name of sid of it | "None", home directory of it | "None") of local users

Users & Groups.title: Local Group Integrity
Users & Groups.desc: Audit of all members within the local Administrators group
Users & Groups.code: (if (exists local group "Administrators") then (concatenation " || " of (it as string) of members of local group "Administrators") else "None")

Data Parsing (JSON & XML).title: Simple JSON Key Extraction
Data Parsing (JSON & XML).desc: Pulls a single value from a JSON payload
Data Parsing (JSON & XML).code: value of key "user" of json of "%7b%22user%22:%22admin%22%7d"

Data Parsing (JSON & XML).title: Simple XML Node Value
Data Parsing (JSON & XML).desc: Retrieves text from a basic XML node
Data Parsing (JSON & XML).code: node value of xpath "/root/item/text()" of xml document of "<root><item>test</item></root>"

Data Parsing (JSON & XML).title: JSON Array & Key Extraction
Data Parsing (JSON & XML).desc: Safe extraction of keys and elements from structured JSON strings
Data Parsing (JSON & XML).code: (value of key "user" of it as string | "None", concatenation " || " of (elements of (value of key "roles" of it) as string)) of json of "%7b%22user%22:%22admin%22,%22roles%22:[1,2,3]%7d"

Data Parsing (JSON & XML).title: XML Document Forensics
Data Parsing (JSON & XML).desc: Using XPaths to retrieve node values and attribute data
Data Parsing (JSON & XML).code: (node value of xpaths ("/config/user/text()") of it | "None", node value of xpaths ("/config/@active") of it | "None") of xml document of "<config active=%22true%22><user>admin</user></config>"

Advanced Logic.title: Simple Concatenation
Advanced Logic.desc: Combines a list of results into a single comma-separated string

Advanced Logic.title: 1024-Char Output Chunking
Advanced Logic.desc: Splits large relevance results into 1024-character chunks for console compatibility
Advanced Logic.code: (if length of it >= 1024 then firsts 1024 of it else it) of (it & following text of it) of characters whose (start of it mod 1024 = 0) of ("Large_Data_String")

Advanced Logic.title: Dynamic JSON Construction
Advanced Logic.desc: Generates a formatted JSON string directly via Relevance logic
Advanced Logic.code: "{" & "%22OS%22:%22" & (name of operating system | "Unknown") & "%22, %22RAM_MB%22:" & (size of ram / (1024*1024)) as string & "}"
